title: dopeTask Workspace Configuration
description: Optional .dopetask/workspace.yaml configuration for read-only dope-agent-system path discovery.

dope_agent_system_path.description: Preferred field for the dope-agent-system asset/template/reference repository path. May be absolute or repository-relative.

das_path.description: Alias retained for earlier design wording. May be absolute or repository-relative.

das_path_env_override.description: Environment variable name to consult for the dope-agent-system path. Runtime defaults to DOPE_AGENT_SYSTEM_PATH when absent.
